spring:
  application:
    name: board-api
  datasource:
    # javaExperience MySQL(호스트 3306)의 project DB. 빈 DB면 Flyway가 V1으로 테이블·시드를 만든다
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/project?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community

app:
  jwt:
    # 예시용 비밀키 — 실제 서비스에서는 코드·저장소에 두지 않고 환경 변수 등으로 주입한다. HS256은 32바이트 이상
    secret: board-api-example-secret-key-change-me-0123456789
    validity-seconds: 3600

mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.board.post.PostMapper">
    <insert id="insertPost" parameterType="org.example.board.post.Post" useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO posts (author_id, title, content, visibility, view_count, like_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at)
        VALUES (#{author.id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{visibility}, 0, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, NULL)
    </insert>
    <select id="findTagByName" resultType="org.example.board.post.Tag">
        SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE name = #{name}
    </select>
    <insert id="insertTag" parameterType="org.example.board.post.Tag" useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO tags (name) VALUES (#{name})
    </insert>
    <insert id="linkTag">
        INSERT INTO post_tags (post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})
    </insert>
    <select id="findDetailRows" resultType="org.example.board.post.PostDetailRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.visibility,
               p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount,
               p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt,
               a.id AS authorId, a.nickname AS authorNickname,
               t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName
        FROM posts p
        JOIN users a ON a.id = p.author_id
        LEFT JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.post_id = p.id
        LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
        WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY t.name
    </select>
    <update id="increaseViewCount">
        UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId}
    </update>
    <select id="countLike" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
    </select>
    <select id="findCommentRows" resultType="org.example.board.comment.CommentRow">
        SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt,
               c.deleted_at AS deletedAt, a.id AS authorId, a.nickname AS authorNickname
        FROM comments c JOIN users a ON a.id = c.author_id
        WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}
        ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
    </select>
</mapper>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.board.user.UserMapper">
    <select id="existsByEmail" resultType="boolean">
        SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
    </select>
    <select id="findByEmail" resultType="org.example.board.user.User">
        SELECT id, email, password_hash, nickname, created_at
        FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
    </select>
    <select id="findById" resultType="org.example.board.user.User">
        SELECT id, email, password_hash, nickname, created_at
        FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
    </select>
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="org.example.board.user.User" useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, created_at)
        VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{createdAt})
    </insert>
</mapper>
